text.en: Dog owners frequently commend Shane, Connor, and Abi for their patient guidance and practical advice during training and grooming sessions. Reviewers note that trainers explain canine body language clearly and offer helpful tips without judgement. Families appreciate the reassuring approach that puts both owners and dogs at ease.

Clients report significant behavioural improvements, particularly when managing reactive rescues or energetic large breeds on daily walks. Reviewers highlight that structured social sessions in Sheldon Country Park help dogs build focus around distractions. Many owners describe feeling far more confident handling their pets outdoors.

Reviewers emphasize how gently the team interacts with anxious, rescue, or temperamental dogs during grooming and group exercises. Handlers take time to keep sessions low-stress, allowing nervous animals to adjust at their own pace. Multiple clients mention that pets quickly relax and show noticeable comfort during visits.

q.en: What services does Sheldon Dog Services provide?

a.en: Clients use the service for weekly Saturday social pack walks, one-to-one behavioural training, and dedicated dog grooming.

q.en: Where are the weekly social pack walks held?

a.en: Reviewers confirm that the group social walks take place on Saturday mornings in Sheldon Country Park.

q.en: Can owners with reactive or nervous dogs join the group walks?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently note joining specifically to rehabilitate nervous rescues or reactive dogs in a supportive setting.

q.en: Are individual behavioural consultations available at home?

a.en: Yes, trainers provide home visits to assess canine behaviour and establish tailored management routines.
